content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: spike in 500s for requests that require tool-calls from eu-west-1 since 01:02 UTC. Smart-routing fallback appears to be cycling between variants.

sophie-sre: seeing 500s and elevated latency graphs. Request rate steady, errors started ~01:02. Paging oncall-sre and oncall-ml. tagging @mike-oncall-ml

raj-ml: suspicious — logs show fallback picks a quantized variant that lacks tool-calling ABI. When the request needs tool metadata, it errors and triggers a fallback to another region, then back, loop.

mike-oncall-ml: on it. pulling route decision traces now. can someone post example request id? @sophie-sre

sophie-sre: example ids: req=cnx_9f3a, cnx_9f3b. attaching partial trace:

sophie-sre: ```
2026-03-15T01:02:05Z route_decision: primary=eu-west-1/model-a-fp16
2026-03-15T01:02:05Z serve_error: model-a-quant does_not_support_tool_calling
2026-03-15T01:02:05Z fallback: route->eu-central-1/model-b-fp16
2026-03-15T01:02:06Z route_decision: primary=eu-west-1/model-a-quant
2026-03-15T01:02:06Z serve_error: model-a-quant context_len_exceeded??
```

raj-ml: that fits — our compatibility matrix should have prevented selecting model-a-quant for requests with tool_calling=true. There's a bug: policy-matcher treats tool_calling as optional when quantized variants exist.

jen-pm: cs is seeing red — @natalie-cs reported a few customers in eu-west-1 got failed calls and opened tickets. Can we estimate impacted customers and mitigation ETA?

natalie-cs: ticket queue shows 3 high-priority customers complaining about broken tool calls since 01:05. They're on dedicated plans but routed through smart-routing. We're triaging with them.

kevin-runtime: quick note — runtime marks quantized models as compatible if they share same ops, but we forgot to check for tool-call shims (tool calling depends on extra syscall/context). I'll push a hotfix to compatibility validator now.

mike-oncall-ml: mitigation plan: 1) disable smart-routing policy that prefers quantized variants for tool_calling requests in eu-west-1 2) pin active traffic to fp16 variants 3) roll compatibility patch to policy-matcher and validator.

sophie-sre: executing temporary override: `redwoodctl routes update --region eu-west-1 --selector "workload:tool_calling=true" --force-variant model-a-fp16` — running now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot started: apply routing override to eu-west-1 at 01:10:32Z. Change id: change_9837

kevin-runtime: pushing validator hotfix to canary now (compat-check v1.2.1 -> v1.2.2). Will instrument additional heuristic for tool_calling capability.

raj-ml: quick check on logs post-override: traffic pinned to fp16. Error rate drops in eu-west-1. Can confirm tool-call payloads succeeding for sample reqs.

sophie-sre: metrics: 5xx rate in eu-west-1 dropped from 12% to 1.3% within 2 minutes of override. Latency stable. Marking customer impact reduced.

natalie-cs: updating customers: interim fix applied, informing them we expect full rollback/patch within 60m. They want details on root cause.

jen-pm: recording RCA: root cause = policy-matcher incorrectly marked quantized variant compatible for tool_calling flows; second-order effect = smart-routing fallback created a region loop under capacity pressure.

mike-oncall-ml: action items (oncall): mike -> validate canary (compat-check v1.2.2) and promote to prod if green; kevin -> follow-up hotfix PR and tests; sophie -> monitor eu-west-1 for 30m; natalie -> close/update CS tickets; jen -> prepare incident report template.

kevin-runtime: pushed PR 1247 with unit tests that assert tool_calling capability bit is respected. CI green on canary. Scheduling prod deploy in 15m.

incident-bot: prod-deploy started: compat-check v1.2.2 rollout to regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1 at 01:24:10Z. Rollout id: rollout_550

sophie-sre: after deploy, doing traffic verification. Running probe tool against representative tool-call endpoints.

raj-ml: verification samples show now the policy-matcher skips quantized variants for tool_calling=true. Good.

sophie-sre: removing temporary override in 5m and will monitor. Command: `redwoodctl routes revert --change-id change_9837` scheduled at 01:35Z.

incident-bot: scheduled revert executed at 01:35:02Z. change_9837 reverted.

sophie-sre: post-revert checks: no error spike, 5xx at baseline 0.4%. No evidence of fallback loop now.

natalie-cs: customers acknowledged the fix and will keep ticket open for one more hour. They asked for postmortem.

jen-pm: marking incident as mitigated. Will draft full postmortem with timeline and long-term fix: add capability flags to manifest, expand integration tests to include tool_calling variants, and consider circuit-breaker for fallback loops.

mike-oncall-ml: leaving final note for rotation handoff: if any regression occurs, page #oncall immediately and escalate to SRE leads. Handing off to next oncall @kevin-runtime for overnight watch.

kevin-runtime: acknowledged. I'll keep a 30m watch and follow on the PR for backport to older clusters.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 01:40:12Z. Summary: ~3 high-priority customers impacted, transient 5xx spike in eu-west-1 caused by policy-matcher compatibility bug selecting quantized models lacking tool-calling support. Temporary route pin to fp16 + validator hotfix resolved issue. Postmortem required.

sophie-sre: adding logs and snippet for postmortem:

sophie-sre: ```
bad-policy-match snippet:
{
  "request_features": {"tool_calling": true},
  "candidate_variant": "model-a-quant",
  "compatibility": true  // should have been false
}
```
